steps.do: Ask the customer for their name, email or user id. Find their record with get_user_information_by_name, get_user_information_by_email or get_user_information_by_id, using the value they give. Do not share any account details yet.

steps.do: Decide which cardmember year to evaluate. The first year's annual fee was waived by the promo if the Platinum account was applied for and opened inside the promo window (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31) and no annual fee was charged in the first 12 months. In that case the rebate does not apply to the first cardmember year, whatever the customer spent. Evaluate the year that starts on the first anniversary of the opening date instead, because that is the first year the fee is billed. Otherwise, evaluate the year that starts on the account opening date or on its latest anniversary.
steps.if: the customer holds a Platinum Rewards Card
steps.quote: If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.

steps.do: For each window, add up the net qualifying spend. Count purchases posted in the window, including authorized-user, virtual-card and international purchases. Subtract returns, refunds and credits in the window in which they post. Leave out fees, interest, adjustments, cash advances and cash equivalents, balance transfers, person-to-person or cash-equivalent funding transactions, and transactions with an unresolved dispute (from the disputes step). Compare each window's total with the $7500.00 monthly threshold.

steps.do: Decide the outcome and explain it, giving the specific reason if the customer asks why. (a) The first year was promo-waived: tell the customer the rebate does not apply to that year, and say how the next fee-billed year stands. (b) Any window of the evaluation year is below the threshold: the customer does not qualify for that cardmember year, and there is no partial or prorated rebate. Name the window or windows that fell short. (c) All 12 windows have closed and each met the threshold: the customer qualifies for the $150.00 rebate. It is applied as a statement credit to the Platinum card after that year's $200.00 annual fee is billed. Use txns to say whether it has posted. (d) Not all 12 windows have closed, and every closed window met the threshold: eligibility has not been assessed yet. Explain that it is decided after the 12th window closes and that every remaining window must also meet the threshold.

steps.do: Ask whether the customer wants a human agent if a record cannot be read, if it lacks the dates needed, if a due rebate is missing after the fee was billed, or if the customer still disputes the result after the explanation. Transfer only if they agree. Pick the reason code from the highest tier that applies: 'technical_system_error' for a tool error or outage; 'complex_billing_dispute' for a missing rebate credit or a statement error; 'customer_frustrated_demands_human' if the customer is frustrated; otherwise 'customer_requests_human_no_specific_reason'.

rules.rule: The rebate is earned only if every one of the 12 monthly windows in the cardmember year meets the $7500.00 threshold. One short window disqualifies the whole year, and there is no partial rebate.
rules.quote: A single month below the threshold disqualifies you from receiving the rebate for that entire cardmember year; there is no partial or prorated rebate.

basis.clause: the threshold and the rebate amount
basis.quote: Earn a $150.00 rebate on your annual fee by meeting a monthly spend threshold of $7500.00.

rules.rule: A cardmember year whose annual fee was waived by a promotion earns no rebate.
rules.quote: If your first cardmember year’s annual fee is waived under a promotional offer, the rebate does not apply to that year. Eligibility begins with the next cardmember year in which the annual fee is billed.

rules.rule: The first-year waiver applies only to applications made and approved inside the promo window.
rules.quote: Apply during the promo window and, if approved, your first year annual fee is $0.00 instead of $200.00.

rules.rule: Windows run from the monthly anniversaries of the account opening date, and transactions count by posting date.
rules.quote: Posting date rule: Only transactions that post within a given monthly window count toward that month’s threshold. Authorization dates do not control eligibility.

rules.rule: Closing or product-changing the card before the evaluation or rebate posting forfeits the rebate.
rules.quote: If the account is closed or product-changed before the year-end evaluation or rebate posting, the rebate will not be awarded.

done_when: The customer is verified and the verification is logged. They have been told whether they qualify, do not qualify, or have not yet been assessed for the Platinum annual fee rebate, with the reason: a promo-waived year, the window(s) below $7500.00, or an evaluation not yet due. A missing due rebate, or a data or tool failure, has been explained and a transfer offered.
